01 — The Sanmon山門

Charred cypress, worn stone, one gate left open.

Midnight Walk begins where the city stops: a mountain gate of cedar burned black, standing in its own weather. The soot is not decoration. It is how a board is taught to survive a hundred rainy seasons.

Climb the worn steps and the worship hall lifts out of the mist, its paper screens lit from inside like a lantern the size of a house.
